purpose: Challenge whether nested interpretation, explicit call data and continuation can be represented entirely by ordinary finite links while L2 exposes only one current-link deictic anchor ↑ and has no host ContextFrame.parent or parent-ascent primitive.

hypothesis.outerDataPolicy: data needed by a child is explicitly included in the child's current link/state graph
hypothesis.continuationPolicy: child result is explicitly included in the continuation current link/state graph
hypothesis.nestingPolicy: call/history/continuation are ordinary links between act/state links

deterministicReplay.serializedCarrier: sorted finite mapping localRef -> [start,end] plus explicit current ref per replay step

counterexampleSearch.policy: do not add another deictic primitive until one finite semantic requirement cannot be represented by explicit current-link/state structure

historicalAscent.migrationCandidate: replace hidden outer-frame reads with explicit data links passed into the current semantic link/state

candidateModels.summary: one ↑ anchor; outer/local/result data are explicit components of current/state links
derive parent/caller by arbitrary incoming-link search
candidateModels.problem: incoming relation is generally non-unique and would create hidden contextual meaning

candidateModels.summary: add a second primitive that directly observes caller/outer focus
candidateModels.problem: no finite required vector currently forces it

challengeAssertions: all scenario nodes are binary links
child receives outer/local data through XC and needs only ↑ plus raw destructors
grandchild can receive a nested explicit current structure without parent ascent
continuation receives outer/result data through XR and no hidden return address
generic incoming search from a current link is ambiguous in the fixture
serialized finite graph plus explicit current ref deterministically replays observations
no required vector produces evidence for a second deictic anchor

releaseVeto.nextGateAfterChallenge: Gate N decision; then integrated v0.6 foundation vertical-slice challenge
